		is_port = yes
	}
	country_potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism }
		OR = {
			has_advance = ship_building_techniques_absolutism
			has_advance = naval_professionalism
			has_advance = industrialization_advance
			has_advance = superior_ship_design
		}
		OR = {
			current_year >= 1740
			has_variable = oe_stm_steam_unlocked
